findings: November still gives factual high-level guidance: after Android app deployment to Stripe SmartPOS devices, an operator monitors progress in Stripe Dashboard, investigates issues and can deploy a new app if needed. Troubleshooting is the only related link and is unchanged.

May also documents the exact Dashboard path (Terminal > Software > choose app > App info > select release version), per-release reader counts by status, and Pending, Served, Installed and Failed definitions. November omits those specifics; this does not establish that they were removed from the product.
The mapped summary preserves the May route and statuses, but Served should be conditional on an installation attempt at the next reboot. An Installed result is separately recorded.
conflicts: The mapped status table says a Served app 'installs on next reboot'. The May raw says it will attempt installation at the next reboot. Keep successful installation reserved for Installed and failure for an installation error.
